mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the risk-free rate component of equity discount rates, leading to higher present value of future cash flows and positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 5-day returns due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the UNRATE rise condition.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust economic demand, which drives positive S&P 500 60-day returns through increased business investment and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of joint GDP and housing expansion are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In an inflationary supply shock regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to the prior month signals deteriorating output capacity, causing negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines in the inflationary supply shock regime.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly acceleration in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.5% signals escalating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 5-day returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in CPI acceleration periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising level of total non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high PAYEMS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly acceleration in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 2050.0 thousand units signals robust consumer demand for housing, driving positive S&P 500 60-day returns through increased economic activity and confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the HOUST rise condition.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) and a stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals delayed monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 5-day returns as investors anticipate inflation eroding real earnings.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of CPI rise and stable FEDFUNDS are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
